description: Hilo Studio's guided contact, in the chat: the same three one-tap questions the website asks (goal, what's holding them back, timing). Call it with whatever the user has answered so far (all optional). It returns the next question with its options or, once all are answered, what fits, its starting price, when they'd have it and a related case. Ask ONE question at a time with its options, in the user's language; never answer for the user. Then you may ask whether the price fits (price_fit). No personal data needed.

lang.description: Language of the answer: 'en' (English) or 'es' (Spanish). Use the user's language.

objective.description: What the user wants to achieve (question 1).

price_fit.description: Optional: after seeing the recommended price, whether it fits what they had in mind.

situation.description: What's holding them back today (question 2; the valid options depend on the objective, hilo_recommend lists them).

name: hilo_recommend
title: Guided contact: what fits
